content.title: Tennyson Sewer Line Replacement
content.summary: The Tennyson Sewer Line Replacement project is set to replace and upsize the aging sewer line beneath Tennyson Street from W. 61st Place to Interstate 76, with full road closures scheduled from May 13 to May 15 for paving. Construction is divided into three phases, with Phases 1 and 2 expected to be completed by late 2025, while Phase 3 is currently paused for permitting and will take place in 2026. Local traffic will be allowed during working hours, and residents are advised to expect travel delays and temporary water/sewer outages.
content.body:
## Updates

Last updated 5/8/26

- **Full road closure Wed., 5/13 to Fri., 5/15**for road paving on Tennyson from W 58th Ave to I-76
  - Tennyson closed to thru traffic during working hours
  - Working hours: 7am to 7pm
  - Local traffic only
  - Alternate routes advised
- **Phase 3**of the project under the railroad is paused for permitting approvals (construction TBD in 2026)

## Overview

The sewer line that runs underneath Tennyson Street from W. 61st Place to Interstate 76 is reaching the end of its useful life and has capacity limitations. The sewer line needs to be replaced and upsized to continue serving the Arvada and Adams County community.

Please note: A [sidewalk and bike lane improvement project](/1031) is also being planned along Tennyson. Both projects are being coordinated by the City of Arvada. However, they will have separate timelines and potential impacts along the corridor.

Both projects will provide improvements to the community. Thank you for your patience and understanding during the construction.

## Timeline

Updated: 7/16/25

Phase 1 and 2 are expected to take approximately 6 months to complete. Timelines are still being finalized and subject to change. All work is weather and supply chain dependent.

- February - April 2025: permit approvals finalized with the county, RTD, and railroad
- **Phase 1 (May to late August 2025):**railroad crossing to W 61st Place
- **Phase 2 (August to December 2025):** I-76 to railroad crossing
- **Pause:**construction will pause while additional planning and permitting is completed for phase 3
- **Phase 3 (TBD in 2026):**underneath the railroad crossing
  - Additional coordination is required to address the complexities of working under the railroad tracks. The timeline for this work is still being determined, more information will be provided as it becomes available.

## Project map

Updated 4/28/25

**Phase 1**will begin just north of the railroad crossing on Tennyson to W 61st Place. **Phase 2**of the project will be just north of I-76 to the railroad crossing. **Phase 3** of the project underneath the railroad crossing is being planned for a later date.

\*Click image to enlarge.

[![map of sewer line project area and phases of construction on Tennyson St](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5258)](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=5258)

## What to expect

- Working hours **7 am to 5 pm**
- **Segmented full closures**on Tennyson Street
  - Approximately one block at a time
  - Detour signage will be in place
- **Travel delays** are possible in the area
- **No parking**in construction zones
  - No parking signs will be placed at least 24 hours in advance
- Short term water/sewer outages
  - Impacted properties will be notified of planned outages
- Additional construction noise and traffic
- Road repaving in work areas
  - Full repaving is not within the scope of this project
  - Visit the [Tennyson Street project page](/1031) for information about planned sidewalk and bike lane improvements

## Contact

Please submit questions or concerns to [Ask Arvada](/898). A team member will be in touch.

### [FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=83)

[Will there be impacts to my property?](#)
:   Residents with driveways on Tennyson may have limited impacts to their property. These residents will be notified directly for coordination.

[Will there be conflicts between the sewer line and roadway projects in this area?](#)
:   While the [sewer line](/1030) and [roadway](/1031) projects are on separate timelines, there is a chance for some overlap in work. If any overlap occurs, the projects will coordinate impacts and inform the community as necessary.

[Is there work planned along 60th Avenue?](#)
:   No. All work for both the roadway and sewer line projects will take place on Tennyson Street. There will be work at the intersection of Tennyson and 60th for both projects to install the crosswalk features.

    Tennyson was identified as a higher priority, and received grant funding from Adams County, for bike lane and sidewalk improvements due to connectivity to surrounding public amenities including schools, parks, trails, and public transit. The 60th Avenue corridor is on the City’s radar for future improvements. The City is looking for grant funding opportunities, including a safety study currently in progress by Adams County.

    For more information on the City’s planning for connecting bike / pedestrian routes visit the City’s [2017 bicycle master plan](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/778/2017-Bicycle-Master-Plan-PDF).

/FAQ.aspx
